u0151.line: Startup TakeMe2Space developed India's first orbital computing satellite 'MOI-1A' (2 Oct 2026) → AI-based data processing in space itself.

u0152.line: Bilateral air exercise 'Veer Guardian-2026' → India and Japan at Jodhpur Air Force Station, Rajasthan (22 September 2026).

u0153.line: 22nd 'Yudh Abhyas-2026' → India and USA at Auli, Uttarakhand and Mahajan Field Firing Range, Rajasthan (15 September 2026).

u0154.line: Fourth 'Samudra Laksamana-2026' naval exercise → India and Malaysia at Lumut, Malaysia (9–12 September 2026).

u0155.line: ISRO hot-tested the CE20 cryogenic engine for LVM3's seventh operational mission at ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri (9 September 2026).

u0156.line: ISRO launched EOS-05 on GSLV-F17 from Sriharikota (4 Sept 2026) → India's first satellite imaging from geosynchronous orbit; orbit raised by Liquid Apogee Motor.

u0157.line: Government targets for 2029: annual defence production ₹3 lakh crore; defence exports ₹50,000 crore (1 September 2026).
u0157.trap: ₹3 lakh crore = production target; ₹50,000 crore = export target.

u0158.line: DRDO's first test of Kusha, a long-range surface-to-air air defence missile, from APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha (23 July 2026).

u0159.line: INS Malvan, second Mahe-class anti-submarine shallow-water warship → commissioned at Karwar, Karnataka (22 July 2026); built by Cochin Shipyard Limited.

u0160.line: 'Vikram-1' by Skyroot Aerospace (Hyderabad), India's first privately developed orbital launch vehicle → successful flight under Mission Aagaman from Sriharikota (18 July 2026).

u0161.line: INS Mahendragiri, sixth indigenous stealth warship of Project 17A (Nilgiri class) → commissioned at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh (11 July 2026).

u0162.line: DRDO tested Pinaka guided rocket (60 km) at ITR Chandipur. Coast Guard's first indigenous hovercraft H-561 → Rassaim, Goa. Jainendra K. Jain → first Indian-origin Wolf Prize in Physics.
u0162.trap: Jain's prize is the 2025 Wolf Prize in Physics (composite fermions), shared with James P. Eisenstein and Mordehai Heiblum.

u0163.line: India's seventh Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) → established in Jammu (5 June 2026).

u0164.line: E85 fuel officially launched in New Delhi by Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri at an Indian Oil outlet (June 2026).

u0165.line: NASA's MAVEN (Mars Atmosphere and Volatile Evolution) mission concluded (June 2026).
u0165.hook: MAVEN letters = Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN.

u0166.line: VISTA → India's first indigenous stratospheric super-pressure balloon, by Red Balloon Aerospace, launched from Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh (May 2026).

u0167.line: DRDO and the Indian Air Force flight-tested the RudraM-II air-to-surface missile (2 June 2026).

u0168.line: Two-day National Conference on Rare Diseases → New Delhi (5–6 May 2026).

u0169.line: World Health Statistics 2026 (15 May 2026): about 22.1 million COVID-19-associated excess deaths worldwide between 2020 and 2023.

u0170.line: SMILE (Solar wind Magnetosphere Ionosphere Link Explorer) → joint mission of Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) and European Space Agency (ESA) (May 2026).
u0170.hook: SMILE letters = Solar wind Magnetosphere Ionosphere Link Explorer.

u0171.line: ISRO assessing a launch site in Japan for joint Chandrayaan-5 (LUPEX) mission. Cochin Airport → first with hydrogen buses. Haven-1 by Vast → first commercial private space station.

u0172.line: DRDO successfully demonstrated Solid Fuel Ducted Ramjet (SFDR) technology at Integrated Test Range (ITR), Chandipur, Odisha (3 Feb 2026).

u0173.line: Agni-3, DRDO's intermediate-range ballistic missile (IRBM), range 3,000 to 3,500 km → test-fired from ITR, Chandipur, Odisha (6 February 2026).

u0174.line: V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority (Tamil Nadu) → first Indian port to start implementing an advanced Anti-Drone System.

u0175.line: 17th Exercise DOSTI → Malé, Maldives (January 2026); trilateral coast guard exercise of India, Sri Lanka and the Maldives.
u0175.hook: DOSTI = friendship (दोस्ती) of three coast guards: India, Sri Lanka, Maldives.

u0176.line: Dr Jitendra Singh opened, at CSIR–NPL New Delhi, the world's second National Environmental Standard Laboratory and fifth National Primary Standard Facility for Solar Cell Calibration (5 Jan 2026).
u0176.trap: Second = Environmental Standard Laboratory; fifth = Solar Cell Calibration facility.

u0177.line: Consumer Electronics Show (CES) 2026 → Las Vegas (6–9 January 2026).

u0178.line: India's first indigenously developed commercial quantum computer → to be deployed at IIIT Dharwad (January 2026).

u0179.line: DHRUV64 → India's first indigenous 64-bit dual-core microprocessor, developed by C-DAC (Centre for Development of Advanced Computing) (15 December 2025).
u0179.hook: The name carries the spec: DHRUV64 = 64-bit.

u0180.line: India's first Green Hydrogen Production Plant for trains → being set up at Jind, Haryana (December 2025).

u0181.line: New Ramsar Sites (December 2025): Siliserh Lake → Alwar, Rajasthan; Kopra Jalashay → Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh.

u0182.line: Indian astronomers discovered a spiral galaxy named 'Alaknanda' (December 2025).

u0183.line: President Droupadi Murmu presented Lalit Kala Akademi awards to 20 artists of the 65th National Exhibition of Art (21 October 2026).

u0184.line: World Food Day 2026 (16 Oct) theme: 'Innovate Today, Nourish Tomorrow'; the day marks the founding anniversary of the FAO.

u0185.line: Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026 → Federico Veronesi; Young Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026 → Oscar Whitfield (13 October 2026).

u0186.line: UNESCO Prize for Girls' and Women's Education 2026 → Morocco's 'Project Soar in a Bag' and CARE Peru's 'Girls with Opportunities'.

u0187.line: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit → India's 29th Chief of the Air Staff from 31 October 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh.
u0187.trap: Ashutosh Dixit = incoming 29th chief; Amar Preet Singh = outgoing chief.
hindi: Chief of the Air Staff (वायुसेना प्रमुख)

u0188.line: World Space Week 2026 (4–10 October) theme: 'Rocket Revolution'; 4 October marks the launch of Sputnik-1, the first artificial satellite (1957).

u0189.line: Amit Shah, Home and Cooperation Minister, inaugurated the 'Prahar' Counter-Terrorism Policy and Strategy Conference (28 September 2026).

u0190.line: World Tourism Day 2026 (27 Sept) theme: 'Digital Agenda and Artificial Intelligence to Redesign Tourism'; official host: El Salvador.

u0191.line: 72nd National Film Awards → Ekta Nagar, Gujarat (22 Sept 2026); Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 → actor Anant Nag.

u0192.line: Semicon India 2026, fifth edition (17 Sept) → inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi; theme 'Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem'.

u0193.line: World Ozone Day (16 September) commemorates the Montreal Protocol, adopted in 1987.

u0194.line: Nobel laureate Michael Kremer → World Bank Group Chief Economist and Senior Vice President for Development Economics (16 September 2026).

u0195.line: Former Chief Justice Dipak Misra received the Kalinga Ratna Award for 2026 (8 September 2026).

u0196.line: President Droupadi Murmu presented the National Teachers' Awards 2026 on Teachers' Day (5 Sept), birth anniversary of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.

u0197.line: Dr Dinesh Sharma → new Lieutenant Governor of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands (5 September 2026).

u0198.line: 73rd Miss World 2026 → Joheirry Mola Dominguez (Dominican Republic); final held in Vietnam (5 September 2026).

u0199.line: Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma → first woman non-medical two-star officer in Indian defence services; Assistant Chief of the Air Staff (Education) (1 Sept 2026).

u0200.line: Ramon Magsaysay Award 2026 → Tommy Koh (Singapore), Runa Khan (Bangladesh) and Bo Kyi (Myanmar) (31 August 2026).
